summary: Group of three Wisconsin snowmobilers triggered a 600-foot-wide avalanche Monday afternoon on the hills just north of the Splain's Gulch Road intersection above Kebler Pass Road; Joshua Lesniak, 26, of Berlin, Wisconsin was buried roughly 10-21 feet deep despite wearing a beacon and died of asphyxiation after failed CPR; Ian McCullough, 28, dug himself out and Andrew Busse, 34, was unhurt; Mt. Crested Butte police, CBSAR, USFS and BLM responded; body turned over to the Gunnison County coroner
location: Splain's Gulch Rd, Kebler Pass Road
responding_agency: Mt. Crested Butte Police Department + Crested Butte Search and Rescue + USFS + BLM
notes: Crested Butte News 2014-02-12; avalanche danger rated high that day with a warning in effect; coroner Frank Vader ruled asphyxiation
